deterministic-validation.responsibility: Run scripts, builds, tests, analyzers, and evidence checks without another model invocation.

high-consequence.responsibility: Handle treadmill control, BLE protocol, HR automation, update rollback, and safety-boundary work.

primary-integration.responsibility: Integrate slices, reconcile evidence, preserve project boundaries, and own final delivery.

read-and-summarize.responsibility: Perform bounded repository exploration, documentation lookup, and evidence summarization.

routine-engineering.responsibility: Implement a bounded vertical slice with tests and appropriate documentation.

architecture-review.responsibility: Review vertical-slice boundaries, concurrency, persistence, and operational failure behavior.

ble-control-implementation.responsibility: Implement only a hardware-evidenced, serialized, bounded, telemetry-confirmed BLE command path.

context-discovery.responsibility: Locate the smallest authoritative TreadmillRunner context for the requested slice.

documentation.responsibility: Update beginner, architecture, operations, decision, and evidence documentation for changed behavior.

final-integration.responsibility: Integrate all accepted changes and own complete validation and handoff.

gateway-implementation.responsibility: Implement a bounded ASP.NET Core gateway vertical slice with deterministic tests.

hr-control-implementation.responsibility: Implement conservative HR automation and every specified suspension/fault boundary.

planning.responsibility: Convert an accepted story into minimal vertical slices, tests, and explicit safety gates.

playwright-validation.responsibility: Run deterministic viewport, interaction, accessibility, and screenshot checks.

protocol-evidence.responsibility: Analyze sanitized independently captured fixtures and verify protocol claims without copying GPL code.

repository-exploration.responsibility: Inspect repository structure and identify exact owners without editing product code.

test-authoring.responsibility: Write focused unit, integration, contract, or browser tests before the minimal implementation.

update-recovery-implementation.responsibility: Implement signed update staging, journalled promotion, health checks, and database/binary rollback.

validation.responsibility: Run deterministic project validation and report exact evidence and skips.

web-ui-implementation.responsibility: Implement a responsive, touch-optimized Blazor slice and its browser acceptance tests.
